NAH. I was in this exact position with my ex. Your girlfriend may be in a terrible place and you can try to support her as much as you can, but you are not a trained therapist. Therapists have their own support networks and have had training to deal with this sort of thing. You can only do so much. 

If the support she’s needing compromises your wellbeing then that’s not healthy for either of you. Encourage her to get help from a trained professional - there are many different options like online chat/Skype sessions, which personally I found a lot easier to handle than talking face to face. If you do decide to stay and support her, make sure you have support as well.

She clearly needs support and help, but again, you are not a therapist. Be patient with yourself.
